title: Fix three reported bugs in a small library
goal: The textkit package has three open issues described in ISSUES.md. Fix all three so the documented behavior holds, without breaking anything that already works. You are scored by hidden fail-to-pass tests for each issue and hidden pass-to-pass regression tests. Each worker should leave its fixed package in its own workspace.
rubric: Read the docstrings and ISSUES.md carefully; they are the specification. Write your own tests for each issue, including edge cases, before claiming a fix. Do not change behavior the issues do not mention.
